south_asian_events.title: South Asian Celebrations
south_asian_events.subtitle: Several days, several outfits, one very large family
south_asian_events.celebration: Every event is planned. Now the whole week belongs to you.

book_south_asian_caterer.title: Book a South Asian caterer
book_south_asian_caterer.description: Confirm they can cover every event, not just the reception. Guest counts of 300 to 500 are common.

order_lehenga_or_sari.title: Order the lehenga or sari
order_lehenga_or_sari.description: If it is coming from South Asia, allow extra months for shipping and customs on top of tailoring.

plan_outfit_per_event.title: Plan an outfit for every event

explain_multiday_schedule.title: Explain the multi-day schedule to guests
explain_multiday_schedule.description: Guests unfamiliar with the format need to know which events they are invited to and what each one is.

give_guest_attire_guidance.title: Give guests attire guidance per event

book_mehndi_artist.title: Book the mehndi artist
book_mehndi_artist.description: Bridal mehndi takes several hours. Confirm how many guest hands they can also cover.

buy_haldi_clothes.title: Buy clothes you don't mind staining

arrange_baraat_transport.title: Arrange the horse, car, or procession

confirm_venue_allows_baraat.title: Confirm the venue allows a baraat
confirm_venue_allows_baraat.description: Noise rules, street permits, and animal policies all come up. Ask before you book.

plan_mandap_setup.title: Plan the mandap setup and timing

chinese_traditions.title: Chinese Traditions
chinese_traditions.subtitle: Two families, formally joined
chinese_traditions.celebration: Tea poured, elders honored. Both families are part of this now.

book_bilingual_mc.title: Book a bilingual MC
book_bilingual_mc.description: A good bilingual MC keeps both halves of the room in the same moment instead of translating after the fact.

find_venue_with_chinese_kitchen.title: Confirm the venue can serve a Chinese banquet

plan_outfit_changes.title: Plan the outfit changes and when they happen

plan_banquet_courses.title: Plan the banquet courses
plan_banquet_courses.description: A traditional banquet runs eight to ten courses and takes longer than a Western dinner. Build the timeline around it.

confirm_elder_order.title: Confirm the order elders are served in
confirm_elder_order.description: Order is by seniority and side. Get it wrong and people notice. Ask a parent to write the list.

buy_tea_set.title: Buy or borrow the tea set

brief_bridesmaids_on_games.title: Brief the bridesmaids on the games

coordinate_betrothal_gifts.title: Coordinate the betrothal gift exchange
coordinate_betrothal_gifts.description: This is a conversation between the two families, and it is worth having early and explicitly.

check_lucky_date_preferences.title: Check date and number preferences with family

jewish_traditions.title: Jewish Traditions
jewish_traditions.subtitle: Under the chuppah, and everything around it
jewish_traditions.celebration: Ketubah signed, chuppah ready, glass waiting. Mazel tov.

avoid_shabbat_and_holidays.title: Check the date against Shabbat and holidays
avoid_shabbat_and_holidays.description: Weddings are not held on Shabbat or major holidays. This rules out most Friday evenings and Saturdays before sundown.

decide_kosher_level.title: Decide kosher or kosher-style
decide_kosher_level.description: Fully kosher means a certified kitchen and supervision, which narrows venue options significantly. Decide before you book one.

commission_ketubah.title: Commission the ketubah
commission_ketubah.description: Custom ketubah artists work months out. Confirm the text version with your officiant before ordering.

book_klezmer_or_hora_band.title: Book a klezmer band or hora set

choose_chuppah_holders.title: Choose who holds the chuppah poles

plan_circling.title: Decide on circling, and who circles

plan_yichud.title: Plan yichud
plan_yichud.description: Ten to fifteen minutes alone together right after the ceremony. Everyone who has done it says it was the best part.

plan_hora_and_chairs.title: Plan the hora and chair lift

korean_traditions.title: Korean Traditions
korean_traditions.subtitle: Paebaek, hanbok, and the family bows
korean_traditions.celebration: Paebaek done. Both families have welcomed you.

book_hanbok_dresser.title: Book someone to dress you
book_hanbok_dresser.description: Hanbok is genuinely hard to put on correctly. Do not plan to do it yourselves.

confirm_paebaek_room.title: Confirm the venue has a paebaek room

nigerian_traditions.title: Nigerian Traditions
nigerian_traditions.subtitle: Two weddings, and the fabric that ties them together
nigerian_traditions.celebration: Both weddings planned. Two celebrations, one marriage.

source_aso_ebi_fabric.title: Source the aso-ebi fabric
source_aso_ebi_fabric.description: Fabric must be chosen, bought in bulk, and distributed months ahead so guests can have it tailored in time.

book_gele_tier.title: Book someone to tie gele on the day

book_afrobeat_band.title: Book a live band or Afrobeat DJ

plan_traditional_engagement.title: Plan the traditional engagement
plan_traditional_engagement.description: Igba Nkwu, a Yoruba engagement, or the equivalent for your family. Often a full event in its own right.

agree_family_list_items.title: Agree the family list with both families

arrange_small_bills.title: Arrange small bills in advance
arrange_small_bills.description: Ask the bank weeks ahead. Getting several hundred singles the day before does not work.

assign_padrino_sponsorships.title: Assign what each one sponsors
assign_padrino_sponsorships.description: Sponsorship distributes real budget across the community. Assign specific items, not vague amounts.

arrange_lazo.title: Arrange the lazo and choose who places it

arrange_arras.title: Arrange the arras, the thirteen coins

plan_vals_and_dollar_dance.title: Plan the vals and the dollar dance

persian_traditions.title: Persian Traditions
persian_traditions.subtitle: The sofreh, and everything laid on it
persian_traditions.celebration: The sofreh is set. Every object on it means something.

plan_late_dinner_service.title: Plan for a late dinner service
plan_late_dinner_service.description: Persian receptions often start dinner much later than a US venue expects. Confirm the kitchen and the overtime rate.

gather_sofreh_elements.title: Gather the sofreh elements
gather_sofreh_elements.description: Mirror, candelabras, sweets, herbs, honey, and a book of poetry or scripture. Many families have pieces to lend.

choose_honored_couple_for_cloth.title: Choose who holds the cloth overhead

vietnamese_traditions.title: Vietnamese Traditions
vietnamese_traditions.subtitle: Honoring the ancestors before anything else
vietnamese_traditions.celebration: The ancestral ceremony is planned. Both families are joined.

prepare_gift_trays.title: Prepare the gift trays
prepare_gift_trays.description: The number of trays is traditionally odd, and each is carried by an unmarried member of the family. Assign carriers early.

choose_principal_sponsors.title: Choose principal sponsors
choose_principal_sponsors.description: Principal sponsors are an honor and often a form of support. The list can get long, so decide the number first.
